summary: The original diagonal tuples make coefficient admissibility exactly equivalent to the cumulative constraints at the distinct site weights. The summation-by-parts optimization, application of the accepted uniform moment bound with its atomic term, and finite rational simplex witnesses are valid, including atoms at zero, equal site weights, lower-dimensional level supports, and closed-cap boundary sites. The resulting optimized certificate tends to zero relative to the claimed dimension-normalized scale, without asserting failure of the actual polynomial bound.
